name: To My Dearest
source:
To My Dearest is a kinetic visual novel about lighthouse keepers in a world gradually slipping through their fingers like grains of sand.

Join Stefan and Leon as they grapple with their sense of purpose amidst dramatic industrial shifts and unforgotten spectres of the past.

[From [url=https://jettbarker.itch.io/to-my-dearest]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《致我最亲爱的》是一部动态视觉小说，讲述了灯塔守护者的世界像沙粒一样逐渐从他们的指缝中溜走的故事。

与斯特凡和莱昂一起，在戏剧性的工业变革和难以忘怀的过去幽灵中努力寻找自己的使命感。

[来自[url=https://jettbarker.itch.io/to-my-dearest]itch.io[/url]]
